specifications.requirement: An incoming part must not begin entering an applicable resource's receiving region while that resource contains another part.

aps.label: ap001
aps.meaning: The bound resource's incoming tool/part begins occupying the bound receiving region while carrying the bound part. Boundary contact counts as occupancy; initial occupancy does not create an entry.

aps.label: ap002
aps.meaning: The complete modeled inventory of the bound receiving_resource contains a part other than the bound incoming part.

specifications.requirement: Resources declared mutually exclusive must never occupy the same configured shared area simultaneously.

aps.label: ap001
aps.meaning: The first bound resource's configured robot/tool geometry, including any carried part, touches or overlaps the bound shared area. A deposited part does not retain the resource's occupancy.

aps.label: ap002
aps.meaning: The second bound resource's configured robot/tool geometry, including any carried part, touches or overlaps the bound shared area. A deposited part does not retain the resource's occupancy.
